say:1:1310914001:1.text: Hey, whose diary is this? A few pages fell out...
say:1:1310914001:1.source_cn: 咦，这是哪位修士的笔记？怎么会有几页掉在这里……

say:2:1310914002:1.text: Ah, probably from one of my careless brethren.

say:3:1310914003:1.text:
"Up at 4:30. Morning prayers at 5..."
Wow, it must be hard to be an acolyte. Saying goodbye to your comfortable bed so early in the morning... Chippy would cry.
say:3:1310914003:1.source_cn: “早上四点三十分起床，五点晨祷……”\n哇，修士可真辛...

say:4:1310914004:1.text:
"The turnip soup was too salty. The boiled beans were too bland..."
It seems the meals here are very uninspiring.
say:4:1310914004:1.source_cn: “芜菁浓汤过咸，煮豆子又太淡……”\n看来修道院的人吃...

say:5:1310914005:1.text: "... The Hierophant plans to appoint two new priests to the temple... I can finally meet His Excellency..."
say:5:1310914005:1.source_cn: “……大主教阁下将在小礼拜堂内任命两位新的领区主教……...

say:6:1310914006:1.text: Bless Dura above. This brother is as faithful as I am.
say:6:1310914006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这位兄弟与我一样虔诚忠实。
